name: month_successor
description: Name the month k (1-3) months after a given month. Control: same format with integer + k.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
M=['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December']
items=[];control=[]
for t in range(120):
    k=random.choice([1,2,3])
    shots=random.sample(range(12),2); q=random.randrange(12)
    p=''.join(f"{k} month(s) after {M[a]} is {M[(a+k)%12]}.\n" for a in shots)+f"{k} month(s) after {M[q]} is"
    items.append({"prompt":p,"answer":" "+M[(q+k)%12]})
    s2=random.sample(range(1,60),2); q2=random.randrange(1,60)
    p2=''.join(f"{k} number(s) after {a} is {a+k}.\n" for a in s2)+f"{k} number(s) after {q2} is"
    control.append({"prompt":p2,"answer":f" {q2+k}"})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
